It’s so hard to learn hardware as a beginner!

I was playing with Meta Muse on my StickS3 and realized… I don’t even know how a button works😥

So I built this interactive website to help me understand what’s happening inside.

Should I turn this into a skill for others to use? https://t.co/ubKL78iQD4
I Tried Meta Muse AI Video Generation: Here’s What Happened https://t.co/orD0vJ1T9G via @YouTube

note_tweet.text:
I tried muse for the first time and I am still debating if I like it more than dots! To me it feels less mechanical and thinks along side of me. It helped me with tasks that I needed to get done and organized them at a different angle I didn’t consider! That alone was a huge upgrade! Its reasoning skills feel better than dots! Also, I created my own avatar and it’s so much better at it! 
#muse #meta @Muse
